summary: NetClass Technology Inc filed a 6-K disclosing a securities purchase agreement dated August 1, 2026, to issue 100,000 Class B ordinary shares to Dragonsoft Holding Limited at $2.69 per share (the July 31 closing price of Class A shares). The buyer, solely owned by CEO Jianbiao Dai, already held 100% of Class B shares; after issuance it retains 77.93% voting power. The private placement, exempt under Regulation S, was completed August 5, 2026. This is a related-party issuance, not a tender offer; watch governance and minority shareholder reaction.
